response.sql: WITH country_avg AS (SELECT c.country AS country, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_avg) AS wins_diff_from_country_avg FROM country_avg ORDER BY country
